data.long_description:
Presenting a brand-new 4-bedroom townhouse with a maid’s room in the prestigious ELIE SAAB Villas, Meydan District 11.

Annual Rent: AED 165,000 (open to a reasonable discount upon first serious viewing)
Status: Vacant and ready for immediate occupancy
Condition: Unfurnished
Layout: Single-row configuration offering enhanced privacy
View: Serene garden-facing
Compliance: Vastu compliant

This elegant townhouse boasts contemporary interiors, generously proportioned living spaces, and a sophisticated architectural finish inspired by the iconic ELIE SAAB brand. Ideal for families, the home offers a perfect balance of privacy, comfort, and refined living within one of Meydan’s most desirable residential communities.

Location

Located in Meydan District 11, ELIE SAAB Villas offers a prime residential address with excellent connectivity to key areas of Dubai. The community provides easy access to major road networks, ensuring smooth travel to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, Dubai International Airport, and Dubai Mall.
